title: User configuration
description: The file config.json in the agent-code-review folder of the user's configuration directory. It never holds a token: tokens come from the OS keychain or the environment. A missing file means the defaults.

packPaths.description: Extra pack directories, as absolute paths, loaded after the packs that ship with the CLI.

keepDays.description: Days a run's work directory is kept before the next run removes it. 0 keeps every run. The default is 7.
